about.heroBody: Voice Protest has no ideology. It is neutral infrastructure for democratic expression, accessible from anywhere, without physical risk.
about.manifesto: "A street protest measures who can be there that day. We measure real support, with mathematical guarantees that each adhesion is a real person from the right country."
about.sec1Title: What Voice Protest is — and isn't
about.card1Body: Corruption, nepotism, serious negligence, repression, opacity. Against institutions using public money or mandate.
about.card2Body: We don't accept improvement requests, proposals or political preferences. Change.org exists for that.
about.card3Body: Governments, parliaments, city councils, public universities, public hospitals, public media.
about.card4Body: Every event must include a source — press article, official document or statistical data.
about.card5Body: Demand, denounce, resign, investigate, dismiss. Not: ask, request, propose, thank.
about.card6Body: The form validates verifiable source, abuse type and action verbs.
about.geo1Body: Only citizens of the country. SIM + IP verified.
about.geo2Body: Region, province, city, district or institution.
about.geo4Body: A device can be in one national + one regional + one global at the same time.
about.geo5Body: When you join a national event, your device waits until it ends.
about.censo1Body: Verify your membership in a public university, hospital or institution with your official email.
about.censo2Body: Your own colleagues vouch for you. 2 vouches from accredited members to enter the group.
about.censo3Body: Your email is converted into an irreversible mathematical fingerprint and immediately destroyed.
about.censo4Body: The census emerges from verified adhesions. Nobody has a prior list of members.
about.seg1Body: SHA-256 on your device. Your number or email never leaves in plain text — only its irreversible mathematical fingerprint.
about.seg2Body: One real number, one adhesion per event. Impossible to participate twice or impersonate someone else.
about.seg3Body: For high-risk countries. Your IP will be invisible. Available in v2.0.
about.seg4Body: Immutable and publicly verifiable counts. Available in v2.0.
about.openCard1Body: Free API for researchers and journalists. Aggregated data, no authentication required. →
about.openCard2Body: Full source code available under AGPL 3.0 at GitHub.

By accepting, you'll verify your institutional email. The endorsement of the person who invited you is registered automatically.

If you were invited directly by the genesis node, you'll be accredited without needing additional endorsements.

If invited by another member, you'll need 1 more endorsement from any accredited member.

api.desc: Voice Protest provides a free, open API for researchers, journalists and developers. All data is aggregated and anonymised — no personal data is ever exposed.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.principleBody: Voice Protest is built on the principle that democratic participation must not require sacrificing privacy. We collect only what is strictly necessary to verify that each adhesion is real and unique. No identity is ever stored.
privacy.collect1Title: Cryptographic hash of your phone number
privacy.collect1Body: Your phone number is hashed on your device using SHA-256 before any data is sent. The server only receives the hash — never the original number. It is mathematically impossible to reverse.
privacy.collect2Body: City and region, derived from GPS (if granted) or IP geolocation. Never exact coordinates. Used only to build the verified report.
privacy.collect3Body: A random ID generated on your device to prevent duplicate adhesions from the same device. It does not identify you personally.
privacy.collect4Body: Stored locally on your device only. Never sent to the server.
privacy.never1: We never store your phone number, name, email or any personal identifier.
privacy.never2: We never use cookies for tracking or advertising.
privacy.never3: We never sell, share or monetise any data.
privacy.never4: We never allow government or institutional access to participation data.
privacy.never5: We never display advertising of any kind.
privacy.providersDesc: The following third-party services are used solely to operate the platform. They process data on our behalf and are bound by data processing agreements.
privacy.cookiesBody: Voice Protest does not use tracking cookies or advertising cookies. Language and UI preferences are stored in your browser's localStorage — they never leave your device and require no consent banner.
privacy.retentionBody: Individual adhesion data (hashed phone number, approximate location, reliability score) is soft-deleted 90 days after a protest closes — meaning it is marked as deleted and excluded from all queries. The public report is never deleted: it contains only statistical aggregates (total count, cities, reliability breakdown) and no personal data of any kind. No individual adhesion can be traced from the public report.
privacy.sourceNote: All source code is publicly auditable under AGPL 3.0 licence.
privacy.reportNoteBody: The public report generated by each protest contains only aggregated, anonymised statistics — total adhesions, geographic distribution, reliability breakdown. It contains no personal data and is never subject to deletion. It is the permanent, auditable record of verified civic participation.
